dependencies.contract: as_decimal preserves Decimal or constructs Decimal from string; reaction_identity uses int First then Break, no price/time/ordinal components. Imported alias is same binding. Record declaration does not invoke either helper.

Direction policy owns strict trend cross and extreme mirror, exact bullish/bearish and ValueError otherwise; no chronology, lifecycle or numbering. E01–E03 direction-neutral, no local price or geometry transformation.

Order imports bind owner declarations and helpers; OrderMatch has nine items including optional crossing triple, cause tuple and nullable cause time. E inherits mixin later; physical identity, accepted ledger and Order provenance remain Order-owned. B05 scoped closure retained, no new cross-owner acceptance.

MarketChronology retains candles/seconds references, derives main and lower times from supplied index or row timestamps, converts timeframe to timedelta and owns lower index/caches. E02 reads chronology.times/timeframe directly; no independent prefix or input identity guarantee.

Later E consumers use current/previous stop/extreme/zone/reconciliation maps and _dirty_time; optional live continuation only when non-null. Cached cross-order hit still checks chronology identity; nonlive branch uses owner search. EZone construction separately populates main vs exact event timestamps and normalizes selected prices. Steps snapshot active tuple before source group and at terminal frontier; reopened race raises control exception with checkpoint, one catch restarts native computation. Saved record only when not reopened; restoration copies candidate/numbered lists and accepted set, updates lifecycle starts. These are bounded consumer observations, not E04+ closure.
Shared sequence_priority normalizes kind/family and performs dictionary lookup. Passed into E construction by Bridge; E declarations do not own priority or StopAll lifecycle.

Bridge creates E using shared chronology and lifecycle priority, optionally forwards supplied live continuation and feedback scope for initial/final/shared-order calls. In observed native live worker route _run_live_calculation invokes prepare_pipeline_state without live argument; market views update candle indices and closed regimes but no E advance call in these observed sites. Optional external/dynamic live object and its advance/dirty evidence remain conditional; do not claim native live E cache is activated merely by declaration.

LivePipelineContinuation retains buckets and market views; append calls calculate_live_from_buckets and replaces views on BaseException following bucket transaction rollback. This outer route does not establish a direct E02 caller or local E02 transactional rollback.

limitations: Separate source-first local review by GPT, not independently staffed. Existing AST inventories compared directly, not regenerated.
Local source-only coverage; no RAW, runtime, ZIP, new cross-owner acceptance or production change.
Dataclass annotations and frozen slots are not input validation or deep immutability; market chronology alignment, stable comparable inputs and correct dirty evidence remain conditional.

Scope equality is not full prefix proof. The observed native live replay route does not pass a live continuation into prepare_pipeline_state; optional dynamic live receivers remain conditional, not asserted active or defective.

No independent SHA-256 assertion; Git object identities and readback are the publication checks. An initial live provider path lookup returned 404; the pinned main tree identified engine/bridge/live_pipeline.py and its source was subsequently read.
